post_title: Banashankari Room-by-Room Packing Guide: Pack Smarter, Move Faster
post_body:
Planning a house move in Banashankari, Padmanabhanagar, or Kumaraswamy Layout? Packing smartly is half the battle. Most families underestimate how long it takes to properly pack a 2BHK. Here is a room-by-room guide from the MoveABox team.

Kitchen: Start with items you use least. Wrap each glass in newspaper. Pack heavy vessels at the bottom. Mark FRAGILE on any box with ceramics or crockery.

Bedroom: Vacuum-seal bulky linen to save box space. Keep jewellery and valuables in a bag you carry personally — never in a moving box.

Living room: Televisions pack best in their original cartons. If you do not have them, our team brings custom TV cartons for flat-screens up to 75 inches.

Books and shelves: Books are heavier than they look. Always use small boxes. Mix heavy books with lighter items so boxes stay liftable.

Kids room: Let children pack one small bag of their favourites. It prevents the where-is-my-toy chaos on arrival day.

Home office: Label all cables with tape and a marker before dismantling. Back up important files before the move.
